description: This file defines a linked list implementation in C, including list manipulation functions, macros, and list structures, with licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: list_add
methods.description: Adds a new element at the head of the list.

methods.name: list_add_tail
methods.description: Adds a new element at the tail of the list.

methods.name: __list_del
methods.description: Removes an element from the list given previous and next pointers.

methods.name: list_del
methods.description: Removes an element from the list.

methods.name: list_del_init
methods.description: Removes an element and initializes its list pointers.

methods.name: list_move
methods.description: Moves an element to the head of another list.

methods.name: list_replace
methods.description: Replaces an old list element with a new one.

methods.name: list_replace_init
methods.description: Replaces an old list element with a new one and initializes the old.

methods.name: __volatile_list_del
methods.description: Removes an element from a volatile list.

methods.name: volatile_list_del
methods.description: Removes an element from a volatile list.

methods.name: volatile_list_add
methods.description: Adds an element to a volatile list.
